title: The Guttered Lantern → Classic Keep (homage stub)
license_note: Original Mag structure. SRD tools for monsters/spells. Not B2 text.

tavern_lantern.name: The Guttered Lantern
tavern_lantern.desc: Low beams, sticky tables, a fire that argues with the damp. The barkeep polishes the same mug. Door to the road. Stairs up to rooms. Smell of broth, wet wool, old stories.
tavern_lantern.area: Village edge under the keep's shadow
tavern_lantern.environment: Evening lamp-light; rain threatens; safe-ish hub
hooks: Rumor: keep chimney smokes black — wrong for weather.
A stranger maps wet rings on the table and will not look up.
Barkeep: first drink free if you promise to come back breathing.

tavern_loft.name: Lantern Loft
tavern_loft.desc: Creaking boards, thin mattresses, a window toward the keep. Someone snored here recently.
tavern_loft.environment: Quiet; rain on roof; private enough to rest
hooks: A bootprint of mud shaped like a keep-stone.

road_to_keep.name: Dusty Road to the Keep
road_to_keep.desc: A rutted road climbs toward a stone keep. Raven calls. Mixed tracks. Behind you: tavern lamp-glow.
hooks: Overturned cart — blood, no bodies.
Keep chimney smoke is too black.

keep_gate.name: Keep Gatehouse
keep_gate.desc: Iron-bound gates ajar. One torch. Stone scraped recently.
hooks: Empty guard post; dice on the table.
A toy sword in the mud.

courtyard.name: Inner Courtyard
courtyard.desc: Well, stables, doors to hall and barracks. The quiet is wrong.
hooks: Well rope cut halfway.
Barracks barred from inside.

great_hall.name: Great Hall
great_hall.desc: Cold hearth, banners, a cave map pinned with a dagger.
hooks: Map marks caves under the hill.
Goblin-script under a table.

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.desc: Bunks, half-empty racks. Signs of a short fight.
hooks: One bunk still warm.

lord_solar.name: Lord's Solar
lord_solar.desc: Private chamber. Journal open: they came from below.
hooks: Unfinished journal line.
Key with a cave sigil.

cellar_hatch.name: Cellar / Cave Mouth
cellar_hatch.desc: Stairs open into natural cave. Cold air. Distant chatter.
hooks: Torch stubs. Something small lives here.

cave_fork.name: Cave Fork
cave_fork.desc: Left wet and narrow; right wider with claw marks.
hooks: Noise echoes — choose carefully.

wet_crawl.name: Wet Crawl
wet_crawl.desc: Tight crawl opens to a pool chamber.
hooks: Metal glints under the water.

claw_hall.name: Claw-Marked Hall
claw_hall.desc: Old pillars. Goblin camp. A captive near the fire.
hooks: Captive merchant. Crate with keep seal.

farm_edge.name: Edge of Farmland
hooks: Note: to the caves under the keep.

woods_trail.name: Woods Trail
hooks: Boots mixed with animal tracks.

tavern_rumor.text: Rumor: the keep's smoke is wrong — black in clean weather. Something below is burning secrets.
Rumor: three guards went to the gatehouse and only two shadows came back.
Rumor: bandits in the woods tax travelers with poetry and knives.
Rumor: at night a thin song rises from under the hill. Not human. Not kind.
Rumor: a merchant will pay in favors if you free someone from the caves.

tavern_drink.text: The ale is honest: bitter, brown, fortifying. HP feels slightly braver.
Broth that has known better vegetables. Warmth returns to your hands.
A free mug of something purple. The barkeep will not make eye contact.

random_road.text: The road holds its breath. No fight — only wind.
A trail bandit steps from the ditch, smiling without kindness.
A lean wolf blocks the ruts, deciding if you are food or weather.
A goblin scout freezes mid-sneak, then commits to violence.

random_woods.text: Brush parts — a bandit with leaf-litter in their hair.
A boar decides you are an insult.
Goblin laughter — then a thrown rock with opinions.

rest_safe.text: The night is quiet. Almost too quiet.
You dream of the keep falling — wake with a debt of courage.
Something small steals a ration while you sleep.

greedy_merchant.text: The merchant you saved invoices you for 'hero services and rope.'
The merchant swears a favor — once.

curveball_color.text: You duck behind a bush for a heroic bathroom break. A raven judges you. Dignity: optional. Progress: intact.
You monologue at a rock. The rock remains emotionally unavailable. Somewhere, a bard takes notes.
You power-nap for four minutes. Dream: the keep files a noise complaint. You wake stickier, not wiser.
You yell your plan into the void. The void replies with wind. Nearby wildlife unfollows you.
You invent a victory dance early. A squirrel drops a nut in pity. No HP lost. Reputation among rodents: mixed.
You meditate on the meaning of quests. Insight: maybe just walk north. Body still here. Mind slightly smug.

curveball_divert.text: Bandits pop from the scrub: 'Trail tax — or back on the road, hero.' They herd you like a confused sheep. Destination unchanged; dignity not.
Wolves shadow your off-path hustle, too polite to eat you, too hungry to let you improvise geography. You rethink the trail.
A merchant on a mule hollers: 'That way's bandits and bad Yelp! Keep to the ruts!' You are peer-pressured by capitalism.
A crooked sign appears mid-ditch: 'NO SHORTCUTS — BY ORDER OF NARRATIVE.' You respect the font.
Your clever detour walks straight into an ambush. Surprise: the story had budget for one fight.
